mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='EXPIRED',approval_status='REJECTED',is_active=0,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT' AND lifecycle_status IN ('VALIDATED','APPROVED') AND effective_to<=NOW(3)

UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='EXPIRED',approval_status='REJECTED',is_active=0,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE' AND lifecycle_status IN ('VALIDATED','APPROVED') AND effective_to<=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode')) contract_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.schemaVersion')) schema_version,owner_team,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.sourceSystem')) source_system,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.freshnessSeconds')) AS UNSIGNED) freshness_seconds,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.completenessThreshold') completeness_threshold,lifecycle_status status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.evidenceSha256')) evidence_sha256,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.validationSummary')) validation_summary,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.validatedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) validated_by,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.validatedAt') validated_at,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.approvedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) approved_by,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.approvedAt') approved_at,effective_to expires_at FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT' AND is_active IN (0,1) ORDER BY contract_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_config(config_key,config_type,config_version,config_value,config_schema_version,lifecycle_status,approval_status,owner_team,is_active) VALUES(CONCAT('ALERT_CONTRACT:',SHA2(#{code},256)),'ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT','v1',JSON_OBJECT('contractCode',#{code},'schemaVersion',#{schema},'sourceSystem',#{source},'freshnessSeconds',#{fresh},'completenessThreshold',#{quality}),'alert-contract-v1','DRAFT','REJECTED',#{owner},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value=VALUES(config_value),lifecycle_status='DRAFT',approval_status='REJECTED',owner_team=#{owner},effective_to=NULL,config_desc=NULL,is_active=1,updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='VALIDATED',approval_status='PENDING',config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.evidenceSha256',#{sha},'$.validationSummary',#{summary},'$.validatedBy',#{actor},'$.validatedAt',NOW(3)),config_desc=#{summary},effective_to=#{expires},is_active=1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode'))=#{code} AND lifecycle_status IN ('DRAFT','SUSPENDED','EXPIRED')

UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='APPROVED',approval_status='APPROVED',config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.approvedBy',#{actor},'$.approvedAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode'))=#{code} AND lifecycle_status='VALIDATED' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.validatedBy')) AS UNSIGNED)<>#{actor} AND effective_to>NOW(3)

UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='SUSPENDED',approval_status='REJECTED',is_active=0,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode'))=#{code} AND lifecycle_status IN ('VALIDATED','APPROVED')
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED) id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.channel')) channel,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.providerCode')) provider_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.environment')) environment,lifecycle_status status,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.capabilities') capabilities,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.dailyQuota')) AS UNSIGNED) daily_quota,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.idempotencySupported')) AS UNSIGNED) idempotency_supported,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.evidenceSha256')) evidence_sha256,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.evidenceReference')) evidence_reference,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.validatedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) validated_by,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.approvedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) approved_by,effective_to expires_at FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE' ORDER BY environment,channel,provider_code
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='VALIDATED',approval_status='PENDING',config_value=JSON_OBJECT('channel',#{channel},'providerCode',#{provider},'environment',#{environment},'capabilities',CAST(#{cap} AS JSON),'dailyQuota',#{quota},'idempotencySupported',1,'evidenceSha256',#{sha},'evidenceReference',#{ref},'validatedBy',#{actor},'validatedAt',NOW(3)),effective_to=#{expires},config_desc=#{ref},is_active=1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.channel'))=#{channel} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.providerCode'))=#{provider} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.environment'))=#{environment}

UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='APPROVED',approval_status='APPROVED',config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.approvedBy',#{actor},'$.approvedAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE' AND COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED),id)=#{id} AND lifecycle_status='VALIDATED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.environment'))='PRODUCTION' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.validatedBy')) AS UNSIGNED)<>#{actor} AND effective_to>NOW(3)

UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='SUSPENDED',approval_status='REJECTED',is_active=0,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE' AND COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED),id)=#{id} AND lifecycle_status IN ('VALIDATED','APPROVED')
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode')) contract_code FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_RULE_CONTRACT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ruleCode'))=#{code} AND JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.required')=TRUE

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode')) contract_code,lifecycle_status status,effective_to expires_at,IF(lifecycle_status='APPROVED' AND effective_to>NOW(3),1,0) ready FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode')) IN #{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.implementationStatus','IMPLEMENTED','$.implementationEvidenceSha256',#{sha},'$.implementationVerifiedBy',#{actor},'$.implementationVerifiedAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='ALERT_RULE_CATALOG' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ruleCode'))=#{code} AND lifecycle_status='APPROVED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.implementationStatus'))<>'EXTERNAL'
mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle_status governance_status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.implementationStatus')) implementation_status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.implementationEvidenceSha256')) implementation_evidence FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_RULE_CATALOG' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ruleCode'))=#{code}

SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.channel')) channel FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.channel')) IN #{channel} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.environment'))='PRODUCTION' AND lifecycle_status='APPROVED' AND effective_to>NOW(3) AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.dailyQuota')) AS UNSIGNED)>0 AND JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.idempotencySupported')=TRUE

SELECT DISTINCT subject_user_id user_id FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ONCALL_SCHEDULE' AND scope_key=#{team} AND config_subtype IN ('PRIMARY','BACKUP','TEMPORARY') AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND NOW(3)>=effective_from AND NOW(3)<effective_to
SELECT DISTINCT subject_user_id user_id FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' AND scope_key=#{team} AND JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.primary')=TRUE AND is_active=1
